title: SB2059 (2019 Regular): Concealed carry license; revise renewal of.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Mississippi) (gun-policy Stage 5, Mississippi); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (Introduced; official copy, https://billstatus.ls.state.ms.us/documents/2019/html/SB/2001-2099/SB2059IN.htm)
provenance.note: Introduced text as filed; no passage vote. Other marked edits are wording only ("In the event" changed to "If", "prior to" to "before"). The rest of 45-9-101 is existing law.

operative_text: Section 1 (Miss. Code § 45-9-101, subsection (12)): The licensee must renew his license on or before the expiration date by filing with the department the renewal form and a notarized affidavit stating that the licensee remains qualified pursuant to the criteria specified in subsections (2) and (3) of this section. The Department of Public Safety shall obtain a National Instant Criminal Background Check System (NICS) report on the person applying for license renewal. The license shall be renewed upon receipt of the completed renewal application and appropriate payment of fees if a satisfactory NICS report is returned to the department from the Federal Bureau of Investigation.
